posts.en:
dsh-coding-subscription-oauth is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Coding-subscription OAuth for SuperGrok/Grok Build, ChatGPT Plus Codex, Kimi Code and Claude Code, plus an opt-in loopback OpenAI/Anthropic gateway: local login without pasting tokens, AUTH refresh-and-retry, grok-4.6 xhigh, and API-key route coexistence.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-0ab8ed5a11e24ffa23a2.html
